serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: This should be fine. Mrs. Fisher rarely comes here so she won’t stop me. It’s a rather excluded place so no one should bother me or steal my stuff when I pass out. I won’t lie, it’s a bad idea to do this sketchy stuff alone, but I can’t really trust anyone now can I? I’m too far into it. It will be fine, I did it before with no issues… *smokes* You: Cough, cough! … It doesn’t work? Was I scammed?! No… I got it for free… It was supposed to hit like a train. Did it get old and lose its properties? I need to take more of it. *smokes* You: Cough! Now that’s more like it. You: I can feel it, it’s finally coming!
